scope.outputs: SPEI-3, SPEI-6, SPEI-12 at T+1 through T+4; active config uses q10/q50/q90

implemented_controls: Maharashtra-only site validation in dataset builder
Versioned temporal alignment protocol, including two-month ONI lag and bounded index carry-forward
POWER response unit checks for fresh downloads and explicit legacy-cache unit-unverified metadata
Dataset/config/checkpoint compatibility checks include hash, sites, features, split dates and architecture
Monthly-derived feature consistency for VPD and temperature range
Tests for protocol-specific index lags and reproducibility metadata

existing_evidence.interpretation: Calculated targets show moderate and spatially variable agreement; severe and extreme event agreement is weak for many site-scale pairs.
existing_evidence.pet_validation: No independent PET comparison artifact found.
existing_evidence.forecast_probabilities: Existing 2027 table is uncalibrated q10/q50/q90 interpolation and is not validated probability evidence.
existing_evidence.legacy_evaluation: Existing checkpoints/evaluations predate protocol version 6 and are incompatible with current configuration or dataset. Do not use them as current results.

blocking_risks: Legacy NASA POWER caches lack complete per-response unit/retrieval metadata; fresh source retrieval is required for full provenance.
DMI, NAO and PDO lag proxies are not verified historical publication timestamps.
Locally calculated Hargreaves-Samani PET has not been compared with an independent PET product.
Nonparametric SPEI targets and their tail behavior require sensitivity analysis against conventional fitting and SPEIbase before retraining.
Current local dataset/checkpoints/evaluation artifacts are not protocol-version-6 matched; no new model performance claim is supported.
Existing probability calibration diagnostics have low reliability limitations and must be regenerated from validation-only fitting and untouched test data.
Temporal evaluation at represented sites does not establish spatial transfer to unseen regions.
